H6TX07151.name: Alexander Hale
H6TX07151.bio: Energy and chemicals consultant at Alvarez & Marsal in Houston.

positions.stance: Pledges to champion Houston's energy industry and the families who depend on it, rather than subsidize "inefficient competitors."
Will target the costs Washington controls for housing, insurance, health care and electricity.
Says he will "put patients back in charge of the price" of health care.
Will seek federal resources to catch criminals, solve crimes and empower local authorities.
Will fight to cut wasteful spending and ensure tax dollars are not spent on failed programs.

H0TX08145.name: Laura Jones
H0TX08145.bio: Small business owner and Army mom.

positions.stance: Supports raising the minimum wage and tying it to the cost of living.
Calls health care "a basic human right" and supports expanding and improving Medicare for All, including government negotiation of drug prices.
Supports lowering taxes for the 99% by making billionaires and large corporations pay what they owe.
Wants billionaires and corporations to pay their fair share to fund affordable housing, schools and infrastructure.

H6TX08209.name: Jessica Steinmann
H6TX08209.bio: Former Director of the U.S. Justice Department's Office for Victims of Crime and former Executive General Counsel at the America First Policy Institute.

positions.stance: Pledges to prioritize Texas and America "before global elites and career politicians" and help President Trump finish his agenda.
Will stand up to Democrats and "stop Washington's overreach" to protect the Texas way of life.
Will defend parental rights and protect children from what she calls radical agendas.
Will keep fighting to keep boys out of girls' sports under Title IX.
Will continue fighting to end lawfare and government weaponization.

H6TX09231.name: Leticia Gutierrez
H6TX09231.bio: Community advocate and organizer in Houston for 15 years who holds a finance degree from the University of St. Thomas.

positions.stance: Focused on rising costs of groceries, health care and housing; wants to "bring bread back to the table" for families.
Criticizes subsidies to large corporations paid for by working families and touts her finance background.
Wants infrastructure, including pipes, power lines and freeways, prepared for storms like Harvey and Uri.

H6TX09140.name: Alex Mealer
H6TX09140.bio: Combat veteran, West Point graduate, former oil and gas banker and small business owner.

positions.stance: Will fight to ban members of Congress from trading individual stocks and to implement congressional term limits.
Will fight to cut taxes and unnecessary regulations, create jobs and lower the cost of living.
Will fight to protect girls' sports and "keep biological men out of women's locker rooms."
Will advocate for infrastructure projects to protect and grow the Houston Ship Channel and Port Houston.
Will fight to restore law and order at the border, enforce immigration laws and fund law enforcement.

H6TX10221.name: Chris Gober
H6TX10221.bio: Attorney and business owner who previously worked at the U.S. Department of Justice on national security and border security.

positions.stance: Pledges to stand strong for President Trump and deliver his America First agenda.
Wants to "stop the weaponization of government" against conservatives and America First supporters.
Will help secure the border and empower Texas law enforcement to halt drugs, violence and gangs.
Will boost investment in defense and technology so Austin and the Brazos Valley help the U.S. outcompete China.
Will cut burdensome regulations, expand small business opportunities and strengthen rural health care.

H6TX31102.name: Caitlin Rourk
H6TX31102.bio: U.S. Army military intelligence officer who served in the Texas Army National Guard and Army Reserve, and formerly led communications work at Dell Technologies.

positions.stance: Supports banning members of Congress and their spouses from owning or trading individual stocks and increasing dark-money transparency.
Supports tax and economic policies that reward work, and says wealthy individuals and large corporations too often avoid taxes.
Calls health care "a human right"; supports Medicare drug price negotiation and capping out-of-pocket costs.
Supports fully funding Title I and opposes federal efforts to expand or subsidize private school vouchers.
Supports pausing large-scale data center development until stronger community, grid and water protections are in place.

H0TX11230.name: August Pfluger
H0TX11230.bio: U.S. Representative for Texas's 11th District who serves on the House Energy and Commerce and Homeland Security Committees.

positions.stance: Says inflation has outstripped salaries and calls Texas child poverty levels "unconscionable."
Says nobody should go bankrupt from illness and points to Medicare and the VA as single-payer models.
Supports a strong border while reforming the immigration system so legal immigration does not take decades.
Wants Texas to pursue all types of energy, including oil, gas, nuclear, solar, wind, hydro and geothermal.
Opposes the rollback of abortion rights; says abortion in Texas "should be safe, legal, and rare."

H4TX12065.name: Craig Goldman
H4TX12065.bio: U.S. Representative for Texas's 12th District and former 12-year Texas state representative who earlier worked in a family-run gourmet food and wine store.

positions.stance: Authored a resolution to roll back regulations and voted to make the 2017 tax cuts permanent.
Supported the Laken Riley Act requiring ICE to detain immigrants in the country illegally who commit theft and assault-related crimes.
Supported increasing defense spending to maintain F-35 production.
Working to make Washington uphold its duty to secure the border, calling it the federal government's greatest responsibility.
Says immigration "is a privilege that should be reserved for those who come here legally."

H6TX12169.name: Angela Rodriguez Prilliman
H6TX12169.bio: Entrepreneur and startup advisor with over a decade in technology and a former nail salon and beauty school owner.

positions.stance: Advocates universal health care and universal child care, paid for by taxing billionaires.
Supports AI whistleblower protections, AI liability laws, restrictions on AI companions for kids, and mandatory AI testing.
Wants to fund child care, health care, education and mental health care instead of "never ending wars and mass surveillance."
Says she would support the Ukrainian people and that Putin must pay reparations.
Opposed U.S. intervention in Venezuela; says American interests should be advanced "with diplomacy."

H0TX13228.name: Ronny Jackson
H0TX13228.bio: U.S. Representative for Texas's 13th District, retired Navy Rear Admiral and former White House Physician.

positions.stance: Says "a secure border is necessary to ensure a strong nation" and supports strong immigration policies.
Pledges to defend the right to keep and bear arms; supported removing tax and registration requirements for silencers.
Says he stands "unwaveringly for the sanctity of life" and supports defunding Planned Parenthood.
Committed to giving farmers and ranchers the tools and policies they need, including livestock disease and wildfire recovery provisions.
Supports President Trump's executive order to unleash American energy, calling energy control essential to national security.

H6TX13159.name: Mark Nair
H6TX13159.bio: Former Amarillo City Council member, inventor, entrepreneur and educator who led innovation at Anderson Merchandisers for over 20 years.

positions.stance: Says "Tariffs belong in Congress's hands, not the president's" and supports a living wage.
Wants government AI integration stopped until clear rules protect constitutional rights; proposes funding Public AI and a transparency agency.
Calls health care a right; supports medical price transparency, Medicare for All and more funding for rural hospitals.
Supports incentives for affordable housing, restricting corporate purchases of single-family homes, and protecting renters.
Refuses corporate PAC money; supports campaign finance reform, a congressional stock-trading ban and term limits.

H2TX14149.name: Randy Weber
H2TX14149.bio: U.S. Representative for Texas's 14th District since 2013, former Texas state representative, and owner of Weber's Air and Heat for 35 years.

H6TX14181.name: Thurman Bartie
H6TX14181.bio: Former two-term mayor of Port Arthur and former Justice of the Peace for Precinct 8.

positions.stance: Will fight for policies that provide access to good jobs and fair wages.
Supports investment in teachers, modernized classrooms and pathways to success for every child.
Supports smart infrastructure, energy reliability and resilient systems against hurricanes, floods and power outages.
Commits to cooperation, common sense and working across party lines.
Supports law enforcement and says true safety requires stability, mental health support and opportunity.
Supports eliminating regulations on farmers and ranchers and opposes tariffs that hinder farmers from reaching new customers.
Supports reinstating Remain in Mexico, ending catch and release, completing border infrastructure and supporting E-Verify.
Supports cutting wasteful spending, lowering taxes on working families and small businesses, and holding China accountable.
Supports oil and gas jobs and nuclear energy, ending regulations that raise energy costs, and rejects the Green New Deal.
Supports protecting Medicare and Social Security.

H6TX15246.name: Bobby Pulido
H6TX15246.bio: Small business owner and Tejano music artist.

positions.stance: Will stand up to corporations raising prices, cut red tape for small businesses, and invest in skills and apprenticeships.
Says tariffs and trade wars are raising costs; supports fair markets and open trade for farmers and ranchers.
Supports a secure border and removing violent criminals, plus a "fair and reasonable path to legalization."
Says Medicare must be kept and strengthened and supports negotiating lower health care and prescription drug costs.
Opposes school vouchers; supports better teacher pay, smaller classes and skills training.

H8TX16109.name: Veronica Escobar
H8TX16109.bio: U.S. Representative for El Paso, first elected in 2018, and former El Paso County Commissioner and County Judge.

positions.stance: Says "healthcare is a human right" and supports Medicare for All.
Supports protecting Social Security without cuts or privatization and expanding Medicare to cover dental, vision and hearing.
Says returning veterans should not have to fight for care, work or housing; helped secure a new El Paso VA health center.
Supports raising the minimum wage, expanding the Child Tax Credit, paid family leave, and making corporations pay their fair share.
Led the bipartisan Dignity Act to strengthen border management, modernize legal immigration and create a pathway to legal status.

H6TX16152.name: Adam Bauman
H6TX16152.bio: Retired U.S. Border Patrol agent with its BORTAC tactical unit and U.S. Navy Special Warfare Combatant Crewman veteran.

positions.stance: Committed to working with local leaders to make El Paso property taxes more affordable.
Committed to providing resources and assistance to help El Paso local and small businesses thrive.
Says a secure border is essential to prevent criminals and narcotics from entering El Paso.
Will work to ensure veterans receive care and cut the red tape that delays benefits.
Supports changes to keep Social Security in place but opposes raising the eligibility age.

H2TX03126.name: Pete Sessions
H2TX03126.bio: U.S. Representative for Texas's 17th District and chairman of the House Oversight Subcommittee on Government Operations.

positions.stance: Believes America is the "Land of Opportunity" because of its free-market system.
Says he defends gun rights; lifetime Texas Rifle Association member endorsed by the NRA Political Victory Fund.
Supports parental involvement in education and stopping laws that take away parental rights.
Describes himself as a pro-life conservative with a 100% National Right to Life voting record.
Supports building the southern border wall and reforming immigration policy.

H6TX17168.name: Casey Shepard
H6TX17168.bio: Attorney practicing indigent criminal defense in Central Texas since 2011.

positions.stance: Wants Congress to fully check executive actions and supports a strong, independent judiciary.
Supports fully funding SNAP and school meal programs, restoring the USAID food program and ending tariffs that raise food prices.
Supports restoring Medicaid and Medicare support and growing the health care workforce.
Supports tax incentives for affordable housing, fully funded rental assistance and ending tariffs on building materials.

H6TX18232.name: Christian Menefee
H6TX18232.bio: Elected Harris County Attorney in 2020; previously a commercial litigator in Houston.

positions.stance: Will fight to rebuild the American Dream for working families and make billionaires and large corporations pay their fair share.
Calls health care "a basic human right"; supports expanding Medicare, strengthening Medicaid and Medicare for All.
Will fight to fully fund public education, raise teacher pay, expand Pell Grants and champion universal pre-K.
Will fight to restore abortion rights, defend contraception and IVF, and block a national abortion ban.
Supports the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, Freedom to Vote Act and automatic and same-day registration.

H6TX19198.name: Kyle Rable
H6TX19198.bio: Texas Tech PhD candidate, U.S. Army Reserve captain and former secretary of the Lubbock County Democratic Party.

positions.stance: Proposes fair pricing legislation, limits on corporate home buying, and tax credits for first-time homebuyers.
Supports expanding and streamlining legal immigration pathways while expanding documentation for border entry.
Supports stiffer penalties for mishandling personal data and a bipartisan commission protecting workers from AI impacts.
Proposes freezing interest rates on loans for small family-owned farms and expanding sustainable farming practices.
Will fight to protect Medicaid, Medicare, Social Security and Veterans Affairs from cuts and executive overreach.

H6TX19206.name: Tom Sell
H6TX19206.bio: Fifth-generation West Texan rancher, former aide to Congressman Larry Combest, and co-founder of a Lubbock business.

positions.stance: Supports finishing the border wall, fully funding Border Patrol and ICE, and stopping amnesty and chain migration.
Stands for U.S. energy independence and opposes efforts to shut down American oil and gas production.
Opposes any form of gun control and red flag laws; supports concealed carry reciprocity.
Describes himself as "staunchly Pro-Life" and opposes taxpayer funding of abortion.
Pledges to defend values of faith, family, community and personal responsibility.

H6TX20113.name: Edgardo Baez
H6TX20113.bio: Former soldier and critical care nurse who has practiced law for over two decades.

positions.stance: Says the district's educational system has failed students and teachers and lacks accountability.
Says service members and veterans in San Antonio are being treated as second-class citizens.
Says crime driven by drugs and homelessness is not being addressed by current leadership.
Pledges to fight what he calls threats to Second Amendment rights.
Says affordable housing initiatives are essential so all families have a home.

H4TX21108.name: Kristin Hook
H4TX21108.bio: PhD behavioral biologist and former middle school science teacher.

positions.stance: Supports making large corporations and billionaires pay their fair share and expanding Social Security and Medicare.
Says "healthcare is a human right"; supports lowering costs through price transparency and antitrust measures.
Believes family planning decisions "should be made by patients and providers, not politicians."
Will support initiatives that strengthen public education so every teacher and student can thrive.
Supports bipartisan comprehensive immigration reform and evidence-based border solutions that curb illegal crossings.
Supports fully securing the southern border, deporting immigrants in the country illegally and crushing the cartels.
Wants to expand DOGE to cut wasteful spending and grow the economy by putting taxpayers first.
Supports parental rights, ending DEI and restoring "patriotic education."
Supports unleashing Texas oil, gas and nuclear energy to restore U.S. energy dominance and lower costs.
Supports backing police and holding violent criminals accountable, opposing "soft-on-crime policies."

H4TX22197.name: Marquette Greene-Scott
H4TX22197.bio: Mayor Pro Tem of Iowa Colony, attorney and former teacher.

positions.stance: Supports adequate VA funding, stronger VA oversight, "full choice" legislation and mental health resources for military families.
Supports a comprehensive approach: more border security resources, asylum reform, guest worker reform and a pathway to citizenship for those brought as children.
Supports boosting domestic production, expanding child care access and promoting competition through antitrust rules.
Will vote for and introduce legislation that helps Americans find good-paying work.
Running to increase access to health care and protect the Affordable Care Act.
